title: Cross-state representation learning enables prospective discovery of dynamic protein allosteric sites
summary: The preprint abstract reports that AllositeUltra recovered allosteric sites among its top three predictions in 65.2% of apo structures and 70.6% of substrate-bound structures. More importantly, application to MAGI2 identified a previously unrecognized interdomain pocket, tested by small-molecule screening and X-ray crystallography. This within-study experimental finding qualifies separately from the benchmark. Review is limited to the abstract and original-server metadata.
ai_technology: AllositeUltra (structure-aware protein language model combined with physical dynamics; residue-guided candidate supplementation)

evidence.tested: The predicted MAGI2 interdomain pocket was validated experimentally through small-molecule screening and X-ray crystallography; benchmark recovery was measured on apo and substrate-bound structures.
evidence.unknown: Review limited to the indexed abstract and publication metadata; full-paper methods and additional limitations were not assessed.
evidence.ai_role: A deep-learning model predicted allosteric sites on apo and substrate-bound structures and was applied prospectively to MAGI2 and proteome-wide.
